description: Answers: Which public companies say AI agents are shopping, buying, paying or procuring for their customers or for them? The reply opens with a one-line answer and its date. Agentic Commerce Watch. SEC filings · AI agents that shop, buy, order, pay, procure or transact on someone’s behalf · the filer’s own sentence. Sourced from SEC EDGAR; every row links to its filing. Free, CC BY 4.0.

limit.description: max rows, default 50, ceiling 200 — the reply carries total/returned/truncated, and `more` links the full board
